newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr renews high vs on mark, down vs yen in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dlr renews high vs on mark, down vs yen in Tokyo.

text.p: The dollar renewed a 37-month high against the mark but was steady to lower against the yen by Tokyo midday on Tuesday, while the mark fell below 73 yen. But activity was subdued, inhibited by concerns about possible Bank of Japan (BOJ) intervention.
The dollar rose to 1.7350 marks, its highest since February 1994, partly on the mark/yen weakness, dealers said.
